tools.name: search
tools.description: Search active Homejourney Singapore property listings. Broad availability questions are supported; use location, project, or feature keywords only when the user supplied them. Returns canonical listing URLs for citations.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one Homejourney listing document by ID. Returns public-safe listing text and a canonical URL for citations.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Primary listing-discovery tool. Use this when a logged-in user asks what properties are available or supplies natural-language or structured Singapore property criteria. Omit query for a broad availability request; query is full-text search over project, title, address and description. pagination.to

tools.name: get_listing_details
tools.description: Use this after search_listings when the user wants more public-safe information about one Homejourney listing. Never returns listing-party contact details.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Use this after search_listings when a logged-in user wants a ranked, public-safe shortlist comparison of two to six Homejourney listings.

tools.name: render_shortlist
tools.description: Render an already prepared public-safe Homejourney shortlist comparison. Use this after compare_listings when the host supports rich app UI.

tools.name: render_listing_detail
tools.description: Render a public-safe Homejourney listing detail view with photos and an external-open handoff. Use this when the user wants to inspect one listing.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Use this to find active Homejourney services. A provider-published result identifies the provider, package, catalogue version, and price required for quoting and checkout: the Homejourney platform price for standardized packages, otherwise the provider-owned price. A result with priceSource launch_g

tools.name: quote_service_booking
tools.description: Use this after search_services with the selected provider and package identifiers, or with price_source launch_guide and platform_unit_count for a Homejourney catalog price. Returns the exact server-revalidated price before confirmation and does not create a booking row. A catalog price also returns

tools.name: prepare_guest_service_checkout
tools.description: Use this for new customer bookings from an external agent, whether the customer already has a Homejourney account or not. After the customer confirms the selected provider package, or a Homejourney catalog price (price_source launch_guide with platform_unit_count), the exact price, schedule, address

tools.name: get_guest_service_checkout_status
tools.description: Use the opaque status token returned by prepare_guest_service_checkout to check card approval, provider, completion, and payment state. Returns no contact or address details.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_guest_service_checkout" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "prepare_guest_service_checkout" is 958 chars, far longer than this server's median (174). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: fetch, get_listing_details, prepare_guest_service_checkout, get_guest_service_checkout_status · Public sink: prepare_guest_service_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: fetch, get_listing_details, prepare_guest_service_checkout, get_guest_service_checkout_status · Public sink: prepare_guest_service_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
